verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack publishes operating-hours windows, per-day filing limits, or session timeouts for the Sunbiz online filing flow. The guidance pages cover filing types, payment options, processing and browser support, but none of these constraints. This is a fair axis for a government e-filing portal, so absence of evidence is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
